subject: Scaling our hosted plan — proposal & rollout for increased monthly commit
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@logiqcommerce.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: LogiQ Procurement <procurement@logiqcommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling hosted plan: request for higher monthly commit

Hi Avery,

Hope youre well — quick one from our side. Weve seen sustained growth in query volume this quarter and expect monthly token consumption to roughly triple over the next 60 days.

Current snapshot:
- July usage: ~3.8M tokens/month
- August forecast: ~5.0M tokens/month and rising

Wed like a proposal for increasing our hosted monthly commit to 12M tokens with a burst pocket for traffic spikes. Specifics we care about:
- Unit price (by committed tier) and any step-down discounts as volume grows
- Burst / soft-throttle behavior and how overage is handled
- Rollout approach: can we stage increases over 2 months?
- Any SLA or latency guarantees at p95/p99 that apply to hosted API customers on this commit level

Procurement is ccd and will want the pricing and a sample order form/term sheet. Also attaching our usage export for July to help with estimates.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of ML Ops, LogiQ Commerce
[Attachment: usage-report-jul.csv (csv)]
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@logiqcommerce.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling hosted plan: request for higher monthly commit

Hi Maya — thanks for the context and the usage file, that helps. Happy to put together a concrete offer and rollout plan. High-level options below (we can refine):

Option A  12M monthly commit (12,000,000 tokens)
- Price: $0.55 / 1k tokens (12% effective discount vs list)
- Burst pocket: +20% monthly burst allowed (no immediate overage billing, amortized at month-end)
- Term: 12 months minimum

Option B  Phased: 6M (month 1) -> 9M (month 2) -> 12M (month 3)
- Price: starts at $0.60 / 1k tokens stepping to $0.56 at 12M
- Can include a short trial burst increase for the first 30 days

Additional notes:
- Soft throttle: we apply fair-rate gating and provide a graceful degrade path (fallback model variant) rather than hard failure.
- Latency: hosted p95 typically depends on sequence length; for your profile we expect p95 generation latency <= 350ms under the proposed commit and normal traffic patterns. We can commit to an operational SLO in the contract appendix.

Ive attached a short proposal workbook with pricing bands and a draft order form. Karthik  looping you in for any special discounts or commercial terms; Marissa  can you add a short ops/ramp checklist and confirm latency guardrails for LogiQs profile?

Next steps: I can share a DocuSign order form once we agree on Option A or B and term length.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hosted-commit-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Maya Singh <maya@logiqcommerce.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: LogiQ Procurement <procurement@logiqcommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling hosted plan: request for higher monthly commit

Thanks Avery — Option B looks attractive because it mirrors our product launch schedule. A few procurement questions before we sign:

- Billing cadence: do you require upfront annual billing for the committed portion, or do you support monthly invoicing?
- Minimum term flexibility: we prefer a 6-month minimum with an automatic renew unless weve notified 30 days before term end. Is that something you can do for a phased approach?
- Compliance: can you confirm SOC 2 status and provide the latest report; we also need clarification on data residency for request logs (they need to stay in the US-east region).

Also, our traffic pattern has two big spikes/week (batch model retrains). If we keep a 20% burst pocket as you suggested, will that cover the weekly spikes or will they push us into overage frequently?

Procurement will want the exact order form and sample SLA so they can issue the PO.

Best,
Maya

On Tue, Aug 21, 2028 at 11:03 AM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Maya — thanks for the context and the usage file, that helps. Happy to put together a concrete offer and rollout plan. High-level options below (we can refine):
> ...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@logiqcommerce.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling hosted plan: request for higher monthly commit

Hi Maya  attaching a short ops and rollout checklist plus a draft SLA. Quick answers up front:

- Billing: we can support monthly invoicing for committed spend but the most aggressive unit price requires quarterly prepay. Were flexible on the contract term; for phased approaches we commonly use a ramp schedule with a 6-month minimum and an annual renewal option.
- Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (report attached under NDA); request logs for hosted API remain in the region you select (we can pin LogiQ to us-east-1).
- Burst handling: a 20% burst pocket will usually cover weekly spikes if they are brief (minutes). For sustained multi-hour spikes we recommend coupling the burst pocket with a temporary burst top-up request (we can provision additional capacity within 2 business days).

Proposed mini rollout (ops):
1) Week 0: Sign order form and confirm us-east data residency + keys
2) Week 1: Stage to 6M commit; update rate-limit policy & burst pocket
3) Week 3: Monitor metrics & run guided load test (we provide a short test harness)
4) Week 5: Move to 9M commit
5) Week 9: Finalize at 12M commit and close ramp review

SLA highlights (from attached draft):
- Availability: 99.9% monthly for hosted API
- Latency guardrail: p95 generation latency <= 300ms for sequences <= 128 tokens for your expected profile (we include a benchmarking appendix)
- Operational support: priority Slack channel + 24hr escalation for production incidents

Attachments: ops-rollout-checklist.md, sla-draft.pdf

If the commercial terms look good Avery, I can bake the SLA appendix into the order form.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops-rollout-checklist.md (text)]
[Attachment: sla-draft.pdf (pdf)]
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Scaling hosted plan: request for higher monthly commit

Great — thanks all. Per Marissas note, we can do the phased ramp with a 6-month minimum and the SLA appendix included. Ive prepared an order form (see attachment) and created a DocuSign envelope for Option B (phased ramp). Please review and, if acceptable, procurement can sign the DocuSign envelope and issue the PO.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/example-id-9082
Attached: order-form.xlsx (includes billing cadence checkbox for monthly vs quarterly prepay)

PO timeline requested: please try to return signed DocuSign/PO by Tue, Aug 28 so we can begin the Week 1 stage on Sep 4.

Happy to jump on a quick call if anyone wants to walk through the order form.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
